base_topic_help: Must match the device topic base configured on the panel. Unique per panel.
ha_prefix_help: Topic prefix the panel listens on for entity state. Same on every panel.
devices_info: Nothing reaches the panels until you click Refresh detected devices and save; until then each panel keeps the layout it has, whatever an earlier version left. Saving after Refresh publishes every ticked row and every row under Manual entities, even with nothing ticked; each panel then removes its tiles for everything else. Export each panel's tile layout first if you want to keep it.
refresh_result: %s devices detected, %s of them new. Tick Show on panels for each device the panels should get, then save. Saving also publishes every row under Manual entities.
manual_info: States no detection reaches, such as a helper in 0_userdata.0. Every row here is shown on the panels. The name is optional; the kind matters only for a date/time state that holds no value yet.
preview_entity_help: Shows the exact topic and payload this object would publish to a panel.
pair_info: A panel with no broker credentials cannot announce itself over MQTT. Enter its IP address or hostname to push the credentials configured above and restart it. Panels that already announced themselves can be re-paired from their control.pair button.
history_instance_help: The history, SQL or InfluxDB instance the panels read graphs and timelines from. With none chosen, the system's default history instance is used, if one is set.
energy_info: Cumulative meters that only grow, such as a kWh or m³ total; never a counter that resets daily, such as energy today or a daily yield: its week and month would be wrong. Energy tiles show each meter's consumption today by the hour, and over the week and the month by the day, from the history instance on the Advanced tab. Enable logging for each meter there. An export meter, such as grid feed-in, counts negative. A price adds a cost entry in the currency below; a category with two or more meters also gets its total. On a panel, pick the meters as energy.<name>. Like devices, meters reach the panels only once Refresh detected devices on the Devices tab has been clicked and saved; from then on they are published even with no device ticked, and each panel removes its tiles for everything else. Export each panel's tile layout first if you want to keep it.
currency_help: The unit of the prices above, shown on cost entries.
coalesce_ms_help: Bursts inside this window publish once. The final value is always delivered.
max_publish_queue_help: When the queue is full the oldest message is dropped.
protocol_trace_help: Verbose per-message logging. Use only while diagnosing.
